column4: A small child giggling softly, close and breathy, outdoors at night, hidden among tall dry corn stalks; no music
A little boy's muffled giggle behind his hands, then a short sniff, a few metres away in a dry cornfield at night, leaves rustling once; no music
Small light bare feet of a child walking slowly right behind the listener through dry corn stalks at night, leaves brushing and crackling, close; no voices, no music
A small cold wet hand gripping a person's hand, a soft damp squeeze of skin and a sleeve's fabric, very close and dry; no voices
A small boy's sudden piercing shriek right into the ear, distorted, cracking into something too deep and wet at the end, horror, very close; no music
A child's neck turning far too far, slow wet cartilage crackling and small bones clicking one by one, very close, horror; no voices, no music

A small child crawling quickly on hands and knees through shallow water inside a narrow concrete pipe, small palms slapping the water, wet splashes, metallic echo, a few metres behind the listener; no voices, no music
Quick excited breathing of a young kid, close, inside a small concrete tunnel with a metallic echo, then a short soft laugh; no music
